title: P0/P1 Incident Response and Remediation Procedure
purpose: Define standard operating protocol for triaging, mitigating, and documenting high-severity production outages.
scope: All production services, customer-facing APIs, and critical internal infrastructure.
prerequisites: Production SSH access or AWS/GCP admin role

steps.title: Acknowledge and Declare Incident
steps.description: Acknowledge the alert within 5 minutes in PagerDuty and declare severity (P0 or P1). Designate Incident Commander (IC).
steps.verificationCriteria: Incident ticket created and #incident-war-room channel active with pinned incident status.
steps.fallbackOrEscalation: If primary does not respond within 7 minutes, escalate to Secondary On-Call.

steps.title: Establish Stakeholder Communication
steps.description: Publish initial public notification to Statuspage within 15 minutes stating 'Investigating elevated error rates'.
steps.verificationCriteria: Statuspage updated and internal Slack #general notified with war room link.
steps.fallbackOrEscalation: Notify VP of Engineering if customer-facing downtime exceeds 30 minutes.

steps.title: Mitigate and Isolate Root Cause
steps.description: Execute rollback of recent deployments or traffic shedding to secondary region to restore service availability.
steps.verificationCriteria: Core API error rate falls below 0.1% for 10 consecutive minutes.
steps.fallbackOrEscalation: Engage third-party vendor emergency hotline if underlying cloud provider outage occurs.

steps.title: Publish Post-Mortem & Brain Update
steps.description: Conduct blameless post-mortem meeting within 48 hours and log action items and architecture changes in repository.
steps.verificationCriteria: Post-mortem document reviewed, action items assigned in issue tracker.
steps.fallbackOrEscalation: Review outstanding action items in monthly operational review.

auditChecklist: Was the incident declared within the 5-minute SLA?
Did Statuspage receive updates every 30 minutes until resolution?
Were post-mortem action items committed to the issue tracker?
